messages.subject: ctmm summer webinar
parts:
There will be a 1-hour ctmm webinar next month (August, 2020), followed by a 1-hour question-and-answer session. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/poll/xtxv5532k8w58vnf

The webinar will take place using the same Skype group as before, "ctmm webinar". If you didn't participate last time, then I will need your Skype user name to add to the group. From the fall poll, the topic is scheduled to be periodicities, but I will start with introductory material and then we can cover whatever material you want.
